svg.title: Zeref, the moonwraith of NavisWORLD
svg.desc: Zeref the Moonwraith, a black fluffy cat dragon with violet starry eyes, crescent mark, moon horns, star wings, smoky tail and gem choker: a young digital creature living his own little loop (sits in the middle, blinks, twitches an ear; floats left, wings flapping; watches the orbiting spark drift close and bats at it twice (spark CONNECTED); floats across to the other side; stretches long and low, tail swishing; settles down and yawns; looks slowly around for about 7 s (diary mood is not sleepy); perks up with a hop and starry eyes (spark CONNECTED); floats back home to the middle; loop 32 s, seeded from the pinned sha and heartbeat tick, never random) at the centre of a slow galaxy swirl with nebula clouds and orbiting sparks.
